verdict.rationale: Reader exposes only a single-URL fetch endpoint (r.jina.ai) plus a proxy pool for anti-bot handling and a 5-minute cache, which could be scripted into a loop for many URLs, but there is no documented batch/async job API, concurrency limits, or throughput guarantees for scraping 'thousands' of URLs. Community reports also note unclear rate limits and intermittent auth/404 errors, suggesting scale reliability is unproven. missing for 10: dedicated batch/bulk endpoint, documented concurrency/rate limits, async job queue or status polling, evidence of successful large-scale runs.
